vetSays.line: 🛡️ Olivia, Boris and Sigrun met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Olivia, Boris, Sigrun are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Kofi, Javier and Danylo met them at the door — 3 put down. Kofi, Javier are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sari just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Javier, Danylo, Olivia and Nino met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 barely walked away. Javier, Danylo, Olivia, Nino are hurt.
🛡️ Danylo, Meruert, Olivia, Nino and Ruth met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Danylo, Meruert, Ruth are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruth just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Danylo, Nino, Ruth and Boris met them at the door — 4 put down. Danylo, Nino are hurt.
🛡️ Ruth, Boris, Aroha, Liam and Zoltan met them at the door — 4 put down. Zoltan didn't come back. Ruth, Aroha, Liam are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Suparman met them at the door — 1 put down. Suparman is hurt.

regDeaths.name: the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still
